primary_observed_fact: The October 14, 2026 6-K announces Santander's irrevocable optional early redemption of all outstanding 4.750% Non-Step-Up Non-Cumulative Contingent Convertible Perpetual Preferred Tier 1 Securities on November 12, 2026 at nominal amount plus accrued but unpaid distribution. This is a bank-capital security redemption, not a common-equity issuer tender, reverse split/fractional entitlement, SPAC redemption, ETF liquidation, or CEF rights offering.
decision_reason: The filing contains a real redemption mechanism, but for Santander CoCo/Tier-1 securities. It does not satisfy any currently frozen common-equity/fund/SPAC event protocol, so no selected security price or payoff is read under those families.
